Search API

Send a query to the search endpoint and read the documents that come back from the selected providers.

Request

curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/v1/search \
  -H "authorization: Bearer $AYLENS_API_KEY" \
  -d '{"query":"example","sources":["url-fetch"]}'

Response fields

FieldMeaning
markdownStructured document content
textPlain text for existing consumers

See the configuration guide for provider options.
